abonnement.demo_banner_desc: All medical modules are fully unlocked for testing: Electronic Health Records (EHR), Triage & Vitals, Specialized Consultations, Inpatients & Beds, Hospital Pharmacy, HMO Billing & Health Insurance, and SYSCOHADA Accounting.

landing.hero_title: Digitize clinical pathways and secure your healthcare revenues
landing.hero_subtitle: From large hospital centers to health posts: 360° medical tracking, emergency triage, secure PDF prescriptions, bed management, pharmacy and insurance third-party billing.
landing.modules_title: Comprehensive Functional Suite for Healthcare Providers
landing.modules_subtitle: Every module has been rigorously designed alongside practicing physicians, nurses, and hospital managers.

triage.title: Triage & Vital Signs
triage.desc: Ultra-fast recording of vitals (BP, Temp, Pulse, SpO2, Blood Sugar, Weight, auto BMI) with international triage classification (Red / Yellow / Green).

consultations.title: Consultations & 360° Patient Record
consultations.desc: Lifetime Electronic Medical Record (EMR/MPI), clinical history, ICD-10 codified diagnoses, allergy alert banner and chronic conditions.

ordonnances.title: Secure Medical PDF Prescriptions
ordonnances.desc: Multi-line prescription engine, instant generation of official A5 medical prescriptions ready for print or WhatsApp delivery.

hospitalisation.title: Inpatient Care & Bed Management
hospitalisation.desc: Visual bed occupancy grid by ward (Internal Medicine, Surgery, Maternity, ICU), stay tracking and nurse shift handover.

pharmacie.title: Hospital Pharmacy & INN
pharmacie.desc: Strict batch traceability, expiration tracking, stockout alerts and direct link with D-Pharma community pharmacies for substitutions.

facturation.title: Third-Party Billing & Insurance
facturation.desc: Automatic split between patient copay (cash/Wave/OM) and insurance coverage with electronic claim schedule transmission.

comptabilite.title: SYSCOHADA Healthcare Accounting
comptabilite.desc: Double-entry general journal without overlap, General Ledger, Trial Balance and budget management compliant with OHADA standards.

resilience.title: 100% Offline PWA Resilience
resilience.desc: Designed for clinics and remote health posts: keep triaging and recording without internet. Automatic sync as soon as connectivity returns.

landing.plans_title: Plans tailored to every scale of care
landing.plans_subtitle: Instant deployment on secure cloud or local server for facilities with intermittent connectivity.
